procedural_matters: Case heard together with 5 and 6, according to RRS 63,2 GER 1171 was represented by Georg Skolaut FIN 101 was represented by JUSSI Sersmo EST 99 was represented by Argo VOOREMA
facts: EST 99 approaching the finishing mark on starboard tack overlapped with FIN 101 and GER 1171 on port on converging courses.
EST 99 gybed while entering the zone
There was 2 metres between GER 1171 and the mark, and 2 m between the hulls of EST 99 and FIN 101, and also between FIN 101 and GER 1171 when they all finished on port tack
There was no contact between the boats nor with the mark
No boats took a penalty turn
conclusions: EST 99 as outside boat gave inside boat FIN 101 and GER 1171 mark-room
